summary: In the overflow pit, a blinding shock of white light floods the chamber; the sentinels blink and fall instantly dead, filling the pit with their cold metal carcasses.

what_changes.after: dead, their cold metal carcasses filling the pit
what_changes.evidence: sentinels blink and fall instantly dead, filling the pit with their cold metal carcasses.

event_hint.one_line: A blast of white light destroys the sentinels in the overflow pit.
